# 🦞 Lobster Library

> The nano Solana financial trading, deep research, ML prediction market & agentic vision AI agent library

## Overview
73 Solana and x402 payment agents for Solana DeFi, perpetuals, quantitative trading, and autonomous market analysis.

## Categories
- Trading & DEX (Jupiter, Drift, Raydium, MEV protection)
- ML & Prediction (price prediction, sentiment analysis, anomaly detection)
- DeFi & Yield (yield optimization, liquid staking, lending)
- Risk Management (portfolio VaR, position sizing, protocol risk)
- Deep Research (tokenomics, audits, whitepapers, narrative tracking)
- Technical Analysis (indicators, chart pattern recognition)
- Infrastructure (RPC, Anchor, bots, data pipelines)
- Strategies (memecoins, airdrops, NFTs, market making)
- Macro (economics, regulation, forensics)
- Agentic (multi-agent orchestration, autonomous trading)

## npm Packages

- `agentwallet-vault` (`npm install -g agentwallet-vault`) — AES-256-GCM encrypted keypair vault for Solana + EVM. REST API at `http://localhost:9099/api`. One-shot: `agentwallet serve`. Wallet-guardian and payment agents fetch signing keys from this vault. Deploy remotely: `agentwallet deploy e2b` or `agentwallet deploy cloudflare`.

## API
- Index: https://x402agent.github.io/LobsterLibrary/index.json
- Agent: https://x402agent.github.io/LobsterLibrary/{agent-id}.json
